annotations.description: Final-attempt upload failures with destination status >=300 increased or were first observed in the last 15 minutes, grouped by scope, zone, job and destination. First-seen positive counters include startup/backfill observations. Requires opt-in logpush.failures; absent data is not proof of successful delivery.
annotations.summary: Cloudflare Logpush final upload attempt failed

model.expr: sum by (cloudflare_logpush_scope, cloudflare_logpush_zone, cloudflare_logpush_job_id, cloudflare_logpush_destination_type) ((increase(cloudflare_logpush_failed_uploads_total{service_name="cf2otel",cloudflare_logpush_final_attempt="true",cloudflare_logpush_status_code=~"[3-9][0-9][0-9]"}[15m]) > 0) or (cloudflare_logpush_failed_uploads_total{service_name="cf2otel",cloudflare_logpush_final_attempt="true",cloudflare_logpush_status_code=~"[3-9][0-9][0-9]"} unless cloudflare_logpush_failed_uploads_total{service_name="cf2otel",cloudflare_logpush_final_attempt="true",cloudflare_logpush_status_code=~"[3-9][0-9][0-9]"} offset 15m))

spec.title: Cloudflare Logpush final upload attempt failed
